name: mava-gems-stock
description: Premium, secure desktop stock management for jewelry inventory.

scripts.build:all: npm run build:mac-universal && npm run build:windows
scripts.ios:build: npm test && node scripts/sync-version.js && npx cap sync ios && xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' -configuration Release build
scripts.ios:archive: npm test && node scripts/sync-version.js && npx cap sync ios && xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' -configuration Release -archivePath build/App.xcarchive archive
scripts.version: node scripts/sync-version.js && cargo check --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml && git add src-tauri/tauri.conf.json src-tauri/Cargo.toml src-tauri/Cargo.lock

author: Antigravity
